subject: Request: CAIQ / SOC2 — live KMS rotation demo + operator interview
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@oakridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@oakridge.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ / SOC2 follow-up — request for live KMS rotation demo + operator interview

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the CAIQ submission earlier this week. Our SOC2 review team had a few follow-ups specifically around KMS/HSM operations and evidence. Rather than exchanging more PDFs, would Redwood be able to do a short live session covering: a) a live demo of a key rotation (showing the rotation workflow, logs, and rollback behaviour), b) a brief 10–15 minute interview with an operator to confirm separation of duties and HSM custody procedures, and c) a walk-through of redacted rotation logs and attestations?

Scope: we need something that we can reference in our auditor notes (so a recording + attestation would be ideal). Target duration: 45 minutes (30 min demo + 10–15 min interview).

Can you propose available slots next week? Also please attach any preparatory artefacts you plan to show (rotation log sample, attestation stub, CAIQ pointers). I attached our current SOC2 question bundle for context.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Senior Security Engineer — Oakridge Financial
security@oakridge.com

Attachments: oakridge-soc2-q.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@oakridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SOC2 follow-up — request for live KMS rotation demo + operator interview

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the attached bundle. We can absolutely do this: Redwood will run the demo in a dedicated tenant (sanitized) and provide a short recording plus the attestation you can include with auditor notes. Proposed plan below — happy to adjust: 

- 30m: live KMS rotation demo (showing rotation request, KVCACHE interaction, HSM wrap/unwrap flow, and observed tokenized logs)
- 10m: redaction and log export walkthrough (we will provide a redacted sample export)
- 5–10m: operator interview (Jonas will handle infra/hsm operations; Marissa will cover security controls/attestations)

Artifacts we will prepare: redacted rotation logs (JSONL), HSM attestation stub (cert + metadata), short demo plan doc. We will not surface tenant PII or full key material — only redacted traces and attestations.

Available slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-15, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 2026-11-16, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu 2026-11-17, 09:00–09:45 PT

If one of those works we will send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (redwood-kms-demo-plan.pdf). For auditor reference we will also include the CAIQ controls mapping page link in the invite.

Jonas / Marissa — can you confirm you're available for the selected slot and that infra will provide a redacted rotation sample (rotation-sample-2026-10.jsonl) and the HSM attestation PDF? We will also use the operator-consent-template.pdf to capture permission to record the interview.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Security 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-kms-demo-plan.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@oakridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SOC2 follow-up — request for live KMS rotation demo + operator interview

Confirming feasibility and availability. We can supply the redacted rotation export and a short capture of our HSM attestation metadata. Notes / checklist for the session: 

- Demo environment: dedicated tenant, keys created with ephemeral KEK; no customer data will be shown.
- Rotation artefacts: we'll produce rotation-sample-2026-10.jsonl (redacted timestamps and tenant ids) and a one-page attestation (HSM model, firmware version, signing cert hash).
- Recording: we'll record the session and provide a short transcript.
- Operator interview: myself (infra lead) + Marissa (security eng) — ~10 minutes. We'll use operator-consent-template.pdf for recording consent.

Preferred slot: Tue 2026-11-15 at 10:00 PT works for the infra team. Please confirm timezone for your auditors (Samir listed PST) and we'll send an invite with a link to the demo tenant and the pre-read.

Jonas Weber
Principal Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-sample-2026-10.jsonl

Subject: Re: CAIQ / SOC2 follow-up — request for live KMS rotation demo + operator interview

Hannah / Jonas — thanks, that plan looks good. 11/15 at 10:00 PT works for our review team. Please go ahead and send a calendar invite (we'll include our auditor). A couple of quick asks before the session: 

1) Please include the redacted rotation log and attestation in the invite as attachments or links.
2) Can you confirm the HSM firmware version and the signing key thumbprint in advance (to avoid scope creep during the demo)?
3) We'll need a signed attestation after the session that confirms the demo reflects production guardrails (a short template we can attach to our audit — if you have a standard attestation template, please include it).

Also, please send the operator-consent-template.pdf and we will have our auditor sign any required forms. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Samir Patel
